content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets such as templates, fonts, and digital downloads has traditionally been hindered by the limitations of existing payment platforms like Gumroad and Payhip. These platforms impose significant fees—Gumroad charges 10% on each sale—which can dramatically cut into your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments allows you to process transactions at just 0.5%. This reduction in fees can lead to substantial savings; for example, 100 sales of a $97 product translates to a difference of $921 retained in your pocket. By adopting a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can reclaim their financial autonomy and ensure more of their earnings go directly to them.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind selling design assets using crypto payments comprises several key components that work in harmony. Firstly, the deployment of a website using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides a robust hosting solution at no cost. Next, backend operations are managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, enabling automated order processing and delivery. For data storage, options like Supabase or even Google Sheets add an additional layer of accessibility. Finally, NOWPayments seamlessly integrates with this architecture, allowing for automatic verification of crypto payments across over 300 currencies. This stack not only reduces dependency on traditional platforms but also enhances control and security for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment gateways are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, digital templates, or software, the sovereign stack empowers you to take charge of your sales process. It caters to those who prioritize ownership and control over their business model, enabling them to operate independently without the fear of platform lock-in or exorbitant fees. This architecture is for creators who want to ensure every transaction is efficient, secure, and profitable.
Keep 99.5% of your profits with NOWPayments compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of this infrastructure are essential components: the hosting platform, backend logic, data storage, file delivery, and payment processing. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the business logic behind the scenes. For order management, you can utilize Supabase or Google Sheets, both of which provide seamless integration and easy access to your sales data. File delivery is achieved through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring your digital products reach customers instantly. Lastly, NOWPayments facilitates the crypto transactions, handling everything from payment confirmation to conversion rates at the moment of sale, ensuring you maximize profit.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your design assets with this sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: First, set up your website using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Choose a data storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, to manage orders. For digital product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing.
